integrity: Analytic proof of normalized convexity and an exact Gaussian-rational negative witness; stand-alone Python standard-library arithmetic checker. No authorship or independent external proof certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: The explicit sector-map example disproves universal positivity for the source-defined component at \(\alpha=1/2\). It does not classify all exceptions or establish failure of a separate higher-dimensional mapping-class inclusion.
title: A convex-sector counterexample to the proposed Carathéodory-component positivity principle
